## Resources

### Software & Development Tools

- [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) — Code editor
- [Python](https://www.python.org/downloads/) — Python installation
- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) — JavaScript runtime
- [OpenAI Codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/) — AI coding agent
- [Codex IDE Documentation](https://developers.openai.com/codex/ide) — IDE usage guide
- [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview) — AI coding agent
- [Claude Code Installation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup) — CLI installation
- [Claude Code VS Code Extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=anthropic.claude-code) — VS Code installation

### Public Data & APIs

- [Seoul Open Data Plaza](https://data.seoul.go.kr/) — Seoul public data portal
- [Seoul Real-Time City Data API](https://data.seoul.go.kr/dataList/OA-21285/F/1/datasetView.do) — Population, congestion, and urban data
